summary: Listed by the Forest Fire Lookout Association as a gone fire tower in Beltrami County; no other source found describes it.

evidence.supports: FFLA list: Ridge, Beltrami County, coordinates, marked gone

notes_for_editor: Only one source: the FFLA Minnesota list, which gives a name, county and coordinates but no design, date or fate. The Beltrami County fire-tower report (Wikimedia Commons PDF, https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/d/d9/Beltrami_County_Fire_Lookout_TowersTowers.pdf) names roughly twenty towers with GPS points and does not list a tower called Ridge. The closest tower it lists is Linder, at 48.3316, -95.2779. The record's identity and location are therefore unconfirmed. Recommend a human check the FFLA entry (name, coordinates) before this page is published, and consider hiding it. The FFLOS and NHLR pages for this name were not in the local cache and returned 404.
